user.title: Connect to PC Link
user.description: Set up a connection to a PC running pc-link.

data_description.host: IP address of the PC running pc-link
data_description.mac_address: MAC address of the PC's network adapter (for Wake-on-LAN)
data_description.turn_off_action: Action to perform when the switch is turned off
data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the PC status (minimum 5 seconds)

wake.title: PC appears to be off
wake.description: Could not reach pc-link at the provided address. A Wake-on-LAN magic packet has been sent to your PC. Please wait for it to boot, unlock it to make sure pc-link is running, then click **Confirm** to retry the connection check.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to pc-link. Check the host, port, and that pc-link is running.
error.still_cannot_connect: Still unable to reach pc-link. Make sure the PC is on, unlocked, and pc-link is running, then try again.
